instructions: Save inputs.json as a list of company objects. All financial amounts and shares in millions of currency units. All future numerical inputs are analyst assumptions unless explicitly identified otherwise. Supply your own annual 2026-2035 arrays; do not only give terminal CAGR. Root engine handles common DCF and return calculations. Can also provide justified custom valuation engine for lessors. Common engine adds five explicit normalization years with a replacement-investment floor, except a finite terminal_value_override. Frozen authoritative prices are in outputs/market_quotes.json; regenerate valuations with python reproduce.py, not the original discovery-stage input generators. Expanded research: 16 companies. Annual fiscal years may differ (DECK2027–36). Annual dividend_date overrides fiscal-year-end payment timing and captures dividends before the five-year exit even if that fiscal year ends later. Scenario other_assets_m and horizon_other_assets_m value separate financial assets today and at exit. Annual nonoperating_distributions_m feeds retained shareholder cash only, never industrial FCFF. stub_nonoperating_distributions_m replaces the first partial-year estimate; stub_fcff_adjustment_m is an additional known-event cash adjustment, applied only on scenario.stub_adjustment_date. No new financial figures are inferred from model precision.

company_example.accounting_notes: GAAP operating margins retain SBC economic cost; no SBC addback and no additional future dilution. Existing dilution in shares. Leases treated as operating costs and excluded from net debt unless explicitly capitalized consistently. Identify restricted cash/NCI/pensions. Latest dated balance is not a current intraday balance.

annual_row_example.notes: All amounts full fiscal year, including first FY26 row. Root fractions first annual FCFF for valuation-date stub. Separate source-backed operating drivers from assumed estimates; missing physical capacity explicitly unknown. Revenue equals volume*price where units compatible. Do not add a separate SBC deduction if margins already retain SBC.
